requirements.title: LEADING_ZERO values are PRINT, SUPPRESS, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED
requirements.definition: The scalar default character expression in a LEADING_ZERO= specifier shall evaluate to PRINT, SUPPRESS, or PROCESSOR_DEFINED.

pending.leading-zero-print-value: Positive source/control uses LEADING_ZERO="PRINT" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.leading-zero-suppress-value: Positive source/control uses LEADING_ZERO="SUPPRESS" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.leading-zero-processor_defined-value: Positive source/control uses LEADING_ZERO="PROCESSOR_DEFINED" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.leading-zero-other-value-source-control: Source-control negative changes only the LEADING_ZERO= value to an unlisted token such as "MAYBE"; no numbered diagnostic is claimed for this unnumbered value rule.

requirements.title: LEADING_ZERO temporarily changes the connection leading zero mode
requirements.definition: The LEADING_ZERO= specifier temporarily changes the leading zero mode for the connection.

pending.leading-zero-temporary-change: Use formatted output of a positive real fraction with SS sign mode and LEADING_ZERO="PRINT" on a connection opened LEADING_ZERO="SUPPRESS"; exact field includes the leading zero where 13.8.5 requires it, and post-statement INQUIRE(LEADING_ZERO=; 12.10.2.15) sentinel reports SUPPRESS. Use the dual SS sign-mode LEADING_ZERO="SUPPRESS" control where 13.8.5 makes the zero suppressible; post-statement INQUIRE verifies restoration. PROCESSOR_DEFINED acceptance is source-control only because the emitted zero choice is processor dependent.
pending.leading-zero-mode-restored-after-stateme: The temporary-change plans explicitly pre-establish a nondefault connection mode with OPEN, perform one data transfer with a different statement specifier, and use post-transfer INQUIRE with a nonmatching sentinel to assert restoration rather than merely successful transfer.

requirements.title: Omitted LEADING_ZERO leaves the connection leading zero mode unchanged
requirements.definition: If the LEADING_ZERO= specifier is omitted, the leading zero mode is not changed.

pending.omitted-leading-zero-does-not-change-mod: Open with LEADING_ZERO="PRINT", omit LEADING_ZERO= on the transfer, prefill INQUIRE variable with a sentinel, and expect INQUIRE(LEADING_ZERO=; 12.10.2.15) to remain PRINT.

accounting.rationale: Single paragraph mixes LEADING_ZERO= value restriction, temporary mode effect/restoration, and omitted-specifier no-change rule.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
